errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a legend. The labels for each category and their corresponding percentages are placed directly next to the pie slices.

errors.text_span: Няма изрични проценти, показани вътре в секторите;
errors.evidence: The chart explicitly displays the percentage for each sector (41%, 30%, 17%, 10%, 2%).

errors.text_span: Сегментите са подредени спрямо сродите си
errors.evidence: The segments are not sorted by size or any other discernible order. The phrase 'спрямо сродите си' is also unclear.
The largest segment is "По-скоро да" at 41%, not "По-скоро не" which is only 10%.
The correct phrasing from the chart is "Не мога да преценя".
